title: Commercial Storage vs Warehouse Space in Midrand
seoTitle: Commercial Storage vs Warehouse Space in Midrand
seoDescription: Compare business storage and warehouse space in Midrand. Check access, loading, power, full lease costs and current Midpoint listings before arranging a viewing.
excerpt: Choose between storage for holding goods and warehouse space for daily operations. Compare the requirements, full costs and current Midpoint opportunities.
contentHtml:
If you need to hold stock, records or equipment with occasional access, start by assessing a business-storage option. If staff will receive, pick, pack or dispatch goods on site, assess warehouse premises against that operation. Neither label guarantees a particular size, permitted use, loading arrangement or lease cost.

Business storage or an operational warehouse?

When storage may fit

Storage can suit overflow stock, records or equipment when you do not need a permanent workplace in the unit. Ask the operator whether your goods, access frequency and delivery arrangements are allowed. Check the actual access hours, loading route, security arrangements and any restrictions on staff working inside.

When to assess warehouse space

Daily receiving and dispatch, stock picking, on-site staff or equipment create a more detailed property brief. Check loading points, vehicle circulation, usable height, floor loading, power and staff facilities for the selected building. The word warehouse does not establish that dock levellers, sufficient turning space or power for refrigeration or processing are provided.

What is currently published at Midpoint?

Midpoint is at 162 Tonetti Street, Halfway House, Midrand. Its warehouse comparison and warehouse vacancy schedule show published leasing and conversion opportunities. These listings do not establish an available small self-storage unit or a completed warehouse ready for immediate occupation.

For example, the published 1 Kingfisher Avenue listing, checked on 16 October 2026, gives an area of 4,199.39 m², describes 4-metre clearance and advertises availability from 1 January 2027. Those are listing-source statements, not an independent measurement or a guarantee of handover. Confirm the current condition, usable clearance, works and occupation date with leasing.

2 Kingfisher Avenue needs area confirmation: its numeric listing field gives 3,849 m², while the description states 3,300 m². It is described as a conversion opportunity. The area and resulting monthly-rent estimate remain unresolved; request an approved area schedule, current/proposed plans and a reconciled written quote before relying on either figure. See the flagged property details.

Six checks before shortlisting a property

  • Use and staffing: describe what will be stored and what work will take place. Confirm permitted use, staff facilities, fire requirements and any approvals for the activity.
  • Deliveries and loading: list vehicle sizes and daily visits. Request loading-point dimensions, door types, a dimensioned yard plan and an assessment of turning and queuing space.
  • Height and floor loading: distinguish advertised eaves or clearance from usable height below obstructions. Have the relevant specialists confirm the floor, racking and fire-design limits.
  • Power and backup: provide your equipment schedule. A published supply figure or generator reference does not prove allocated tenant capacity, supported circuits, runtime or changeover arrangements.
  • Access and condition: confirm operating hours, security procedures, existing fit-out, any proposed conversion and who is responsible for required works.
  • Timing and flexibility: confirm the occupation programme, lease term, escalation and options for growth. Do not assume renewal, expansion or immediate availability.

The warehouse specification checklist explains these checks in more detail. Use it with the source-linked unit comparison rather than applying an estate-wide specification to every building.

Compare the full cost, not just the rate per square metre

For a quote based on area, monthly base rent is the agreed rentable area multiplied by the agreed monthly rate per square metre. That calculation is only useful once both figures and their basis are confirmed. It does not establish a complete occupancy budget.

Ask for a written breakdown of VAT, recoveries, utilities, parking, deposits, fit-out, required works and other applicable charges, identifying what is included or additional. Compare storage and warehouse options for the same operational requirement and term. A smaller unit, a lower rate or a storage label alone does not prove a lower total cost.

The live warehouse comparison keeps published areas, asking rates, availability and indicative base-rent calculations attached to their source listings. The Kingfisher area conflict is excluded from numeric estimates until it is reconciled.

Send a clear brief to the leasing team

Include the goods and intended use, required area, staff numbers, vehicle sizes and visits per day, loading and power needs, target occupation date and budget. Ask for the current floor plan, a full quote and a viewing of the specific opportunity.

Discuss a warehouse or conversion requirement with Midpoint leasing. For storage-only requirements, confirm whether any current option actually fits before treating a warehouse listing as suitable.

Frequently asked questions

Does Midpoint have small commercial storage units available?

The current Midpoint warehouse schedule is not evidence of small self-storage availability. Check the live listings and confirm the required size, access and permitted use with leasing before shortlisting.

Does a warehouse listing include dock loading or generator power for my equipment?

Do not assume either. Confirm the loading configuration, electrical supply, backup allocation and supported circuits for the selected property against your operational brief.

Is warehouse space always more expensive than business storage?

No like-for-like price comparison is established here. Compare the full quoted cost, area, access, works, term and permitted activity for the options that meet your requirements.

Can I move from storage into a warehouse later?

You can plan for that possibility, but a suitable future unit, transfer arrangement or renewal is not guaranteed. Discuss growth plans and the relevant lease conditions before committing.
